message: Multiple request properties have the name "body": the requestBody, which the SDK exposes as a property named "body" because its schema is not inlined into the request, query parameter "body". This is not suitable for code generation. Use x-fern-parameter-name on a parameter to deconflict.

Multiple request properties have the name "name": query parameter "q" (x-fern-parameter-name: "name"), requestBody property "name". This is not suitable for code generation. Use x-fern-parameter-name on a parameter or x-fern-property-name on a requestBody property to deconflict.
